profile.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1 and all sixteen prior TCG helpers enabled

exact_accounting.identity: 180 unaffected PCs * 100 services + one guarded dispatch PC * 100 services = 18,100 instructions
exact_accounting.cross_check: The derived uniform per-PC distribution exactly equals the independently measured sixteen-helper handoff total.

selected_boundary.role: complete deterministic handoff composite containing sixteen validated helper dispatches and the remaining single-pass scalar spine
selected_boundary.selection_reason: Every remaining PC executes exactly once per service, so no smaller repeated native segment can produce a multiplicative reduction.

compositional_replay_basis.conclusion: The complete leaf remains the independently replayable deterministic boundary: the parent composite replay is exact, and both later guarded substitutions preserve their validated entry-to-exit architectural and touched-memory contracts.

firmware_version_control.reason: OS 1.73 did not reach the existing 1.72 framebuffer startup boundary under the 1.72 machine/address contract, so no 1.73 result is included in this gate.

conclusion: After the sixteenth helper, the exact 18,100-instruction handoff residual is a uniform 181-PC single-pass spine. No repeated micro-kernel remains; the complete composite leaf is the next bounded candidate.
next_gate: Build a verifier-only candidate for the complete residual composite, reuse the sixteen established helper models, reconstruct only the remaining scalar spine, and require early/late complete-state and touched-memory equality before considering a consolidation helper.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Only clean-room topology, aggregate counts, and compositional contract results are committed. No Elektron firmware, project data, sample names, PCM, runtime values, runtime trace, or instruction bytes are committed.
